description: Ayuntamiento de Cáceres: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Cáceres. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Cáceres. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Carril Bici; Carriles Bici de Cáceres; Estación de Trenes; Red Ferroviaria. Formats seen: HTML, WMS, CSV, GEO%2BJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by), as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
